name: RTC
description: Real-time audio, video and data between peers: calls between LeCodes apps, and with a browser, over one fixed profile (Opus, H.264 through the hardware codec, data channels). tinyrtc on iOS and Android, the browser's WebRTC on the web. Signaling is the app's; a call without a direct path crosses a relay of a tinyrtc media server.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The app uses the camera for video calls.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The app uses the microphone for calls.
